# Knee candidate deterministic export tools — provisional, not a release gate change

**Scope.** Art-tools lane `.11`; no existing candidate source/GLB/PNG, release, ID, set, runtime or renderer was rewritten. The first experiment below applies only to the original three variants generated by `tools/generate_knee_candidates.py`. Derrick subsequently approved the independent `hover-shell-strike-v1` floating strike target **for now** (future visual variants remain swappable), approved `segmented-lightwrap-v1` as the separate wearable pad, and approved existing semantic `.blend` scene fingerprinting as editable-source equivalence. The second experiment below covers those two selected generators. These decisions do not authorize or produce an immutable knee release. All output stays in isolated disposable Cookie `/tmp` roots.

## Exact observed failure and causal diagnosis

Two pre-fix clean Blender 4.0.2 builds (`/tmp/aerobeat-knee-candidates-seeded-{a,b}`) differed in **3/3 GLBs, 16/16 PNG files and 3/3 `.blend` containers**. Previously examined PNG decoded pixels differed in two back views; the rest differed in Blender PNG `tEXt` metadata. Comparing old GLB accessors showed matching POSITION/NORMAL vertices and identical oriented triangle **multisets**, but UV-sphere triangle INDEX *order* differed. `tools/blender_scene_fingerprint.py` showed old source scenes had equal objects, materials and vertex positions but different UV-sphere edge, polygon, loop, UV and triangle order; topology was equal as a set. That is the source of geometric export ordering drift, not merely GLB JSON metadata.

Blender native `.blend` save is also not byte-stable: decompressed old pad files had the same 1,203,180-byte length but ~73,670 bytes differed, including nearly every memory-pointer block address and authored mesh ordering. After face ordering was corrected, Blender still embeds run-dependent native pointers, so the source *container* is not an appropriate bitwise build authority. The pre-existing `blender_scene_fingerprint.py` is a semantic check and does not weaken the strict runtime GLB or review PNG byte gate.

## Minimal source fix and prior failed attempts

`tools/knee_mesh_order.py` reauthors the same primitive faces in stable vertex-index order before source save/export, keeping the same positions, face winding, polygon materials, smoothing and procedural UV corners. No vertices are merged. `tools/knee_png_metadata.py` strips **only** Blender's volatile `File`, `Date`, `RenderTime`, `cycles.ViewLayer.total_time`, `cycles.ViewLayer.render_time` PNG `tEXt` keys, with CRC verification and all IDAT/other chunks left intact. A standard-library helper fixture tests precise filtering, idempotence and corrupted-CRC failure. Previous fixed Cycles seed and disabled TEXCOORD export alone could not stabilize Blender's primitive face order; avoiding whole-file checks concealed image metadata but not mesh BIN changes. This fix does not edit pre-existing candidate art or release bytes.

## Fresh independent proof on Cookie Blender 4.0.2

```bash
blender --background --factory-startup --python tools/generate_knee_candidates.py -- --output-root /tmp/knee-order-experiment-e
blender --background --factory-startup --python tools/generate_knee_candidates.py -- --output-root /tmp/knee-order-experiment-f
python3 tools/validate_knee_candidates.py --candidate-root /tmp/knee-order-experiment-e --smoke
python3 tools/validate_knee_candidates.py --candidate-root /tmp/knee-order-experiment-f --smoke
python3 tools/test_knee_determinism_helpers.py
python3 tools/test_subprocess_contract.py --root .
```

Both generator runs emitted `KNEE_CANDIDATES_OK`; both per-root validators imported all three editable Blender sources and GLBs and emitted `KNEE_VALIDATION_OK`. **3/3 GLBs** and **16/16 PNGs** had identical full SHA-256/bytes across the two roots. Specific repeat SHA-256 values: `knee-pad/dome-strap-v1.glb` `28bb3d0baf8c1283495c267137d8fb9d7868b0be00a1bbf28fb3f1c28acc94fb`; `knee-target/open-prong-v1.glb` `82dd18d56ea279d4c9f2e87b43cd39bf7ab0c4bc15409d0105c0e98a55709d21`; `knee-target/chevron-v1.glb` `8c3103d18d33f806eebda4cdadc384e5b9c4719589c847aaa9ef698d0a1c810d`; pad front PNG `b6de7665943471d75a7c530e15d62f5114c32c78e9696da313aeb016fc652418`. For all three sources the existing semantic fingerprints repeat identically: dome-strap `9b418cb3b1f97ced606196784ba96701b16390d517d4fd7b364b5e798c2f2558`, open-prong `fa286caa6be2ff5863a38b9ab05acb33470fd24dd3e27669b6c3424d1ef1d8fa`, chevron `6efbc720cd384b459fa32d57c6eef92deec1aaaf7254977092df5a917e8796cf`.

**Surviving native `.blend` nondeterminism:** 0/3 `.blend` files are byte-identical. Example dome-strap SHA-256 is `9cf5f5c92ced0d8cc7f3646c8df263745655c3e92234d0ae67d0c1ab9589172e` vs `05dce10091100935ec5ad1411973d13d1800b95036127e54cc5c272742fa73b6`. We do not rewrite `.blend` memory pointers or claim full three-format byte parity. Strict finalized-release two-build GLB/PNG bytes **remain binding**; final chosen models must also validate semantic source identity and strict manifests before release. The original-variant experiment predates the selected-model art approvals; see the new selected-model result below.

**Unknowns for this original-variant experiment.** Other Blender hosts and native renderer visual parity were not tested. Face ordering uses mesh material/smoothing/UV support exercised by these candidates only; do not assume arbitrary layered attributes are preserved by this helper. If a future model has colors/custom normals/shapekeys, extend the source-safe attribute mapping or choose a narrower deterministic primitive authoring path after demonstrating its need. Normalization deliberately does not strip all ancillary PNG metadata; unexpected new volatile keys should fail the existing byte gate rather than be silently ignored.

## Selected target and wearable pad after Derrick's separate approvals

The selected **floating target** is `knee-target/hover-shell-strike-v1`; the separate **wearable pad** is `knee-pad/segmented-lightwrap-v1`. The initial two clean Blender 4.0.2 builds of their unmodified generators in `/tmp/approved-{hover,pad}-before-{a,b}` failed repeatability: both GLBs, both `.blend` containers, and 23/23 PNGs differed. Hover GLB JSON matched but binary geometry did not. The smallest source-safe correction reused the previous `tools/knee_mesh_order.py` mesh face ordering **before save/export** and `tools/knee_png_metadata.py` volatile render-text filtering **after each render** in only `tools/generate_hover_strike_candidate.py` and `tools/generate_segmented_knee_pad_candidate.py`. Candidate source files and historical releases were never regenerated or overwritten.

Four new independent Blender runs used empty `/tmp/approved-hover-ordered-{a,b}` and `/tmp/approved-pad-ordered-{a,b}` roots. Each generator emitted its exact `*_CANDIDATE_OK` marker without traceback. Both selected variants passed their existing SHA-bound per-file manifest validator and **clean Blender 4.0.2 source/GLB smoke imports twice** (`HOVER_STRIKE_VALIDATION_OK` and `SEGMENTED_PAD_VALIDATION_OK`). Full GLB **including all index/geometry BIN bytes** is identical between runs: hover GLB SHA-256 `ab9237a84cb01a4965a0aa7b929c4300652548b043655ec2998b9772e0c6fbb6` (BIN `721ce8da6239dd7c9f84ad63913e054f5054f25514072d02c62735989a5cc8ce`); wearable GLB `2dc4a861acb672d177654123bcb06a9b7155ac5a9cedc4fe860fa24e644a1326` (BIN `a56c49baf30f516963c98995167d9712e014287dd8383107ac1a35697e47bb28`). All **7/7 target** and **16/16 pad** review PNGs matched full bytes and decompressed IDAT/image data; illustrative target 32-pixel view decoded-image SHA-256 `b5046e38f2f07fc7cd5cfa0f1787cf75b8575013386a3b600845d29b5a0873d1`, pad back `499f80e7e4e6b7ace295cd72d1891536051d6626c4e40614a6ce9a84b0ce5143`. Both `.blend` source scene fingerprints match between builds: target `efb191ae62d16b8a541679e5fcc56bbe14467f136de45c7282164c1e1234bc1e`; wearable `02a64338cc8a3fc8115694f71a5b476ebf44a72746c95e17bc705a3e61a8891a`.

Native `.blend` bytes **do not match**, and no pointer patch was made. Target native hash A/B: `3e5f27024e7ce6bce9e6c68064f8c3f29232373179cba824a16ae8557cdd185c` / `e835003c43daa3917266ba11dfd404348b1f3ceeb11a01bdc2b868183d3a5bd0` (2,587 of 2,588 saved block addresses differ). Pad native hash A/B: `bdaa9de7e3b40ae6c695be58a2429ddcb919c8ae73cc19dbdb46d412247bc5fa` / `f587bff5c6835be4772a06b3ea2ba1a533371777c1f3f565163504b2ee02eb2e` (3,012 of 3,013 block addresses differ). Each generated manifest correctly hashes the actual `.blend` *in its own root*; cross-root manifests therefore differ only at the `.blend` file hash, not at GLB/PNG or identity/material/geometry facts. Derrick approved fingerprint equivalence **instead of cross-root native `.blend` byte identity**, not an exemption from manifest validity or GLB/review bytes. The README (uniform arrow, wall, track proofs) already implements this source equivalence; `AGENTS.md` release rule still demands strict validation, smoke imports and two temporary builds.

**Remaining release dependency:** Parent independently verifies this `.11` tool/manifest proof, then decides when `.11` closes and plans additive knee-art release as part of Section D (`.6`). This tool slice does not finalize new manifests, sources, set, release version or native physical tracking/gameplay. The selected-target approval is expressly provisional to allow later swappable art revisions; the pad approval is independent.
